c.tagline: Art deco, ocean breeze, and Latin rhythm

emergency.note: Dial 911 for all emergencies; Spanish-speaking operators are also widely available.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.South Beach: the Art Deco Historic District along Ocean Drive
hood_landmark.Little Havana: Domino Park and the cigar shops of Calle Ocho
hood_landmark.Brickell: Brickell City Centre amid the skyline's banking towers
hood_landmark.Coconut Grove: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens' Italianate villa

avoid.reason: Caution in Overtown and Liberty City; watch for theft/scams in South Beach nightlife

hood_desc: South Beach is the iconic Art Deco beachfront of white sand, Ocean Drive nightlife, glamorous hotels and people-watching, ideal for partygoers, beach lovers and first-time visitors.
Wynwood is Miami's edgy arts district famous for the Wynwood Walls murals, breweries, galleries and hip eateries, perfect for creatives, foodies and young travelers.
Little Havana is the vibrant Cuban heart of Miami along Calle Ocho, with cigar shops, salsa, domino parks and authentic food, great for culture seekers and lively atmosphere.
Brickell is the sleek downtown financial district of high-rise condos, rooftop bars and upscale dining, suited to business travelers and those wanting a modern urban base.
Coconut Grove is a lush, laid-back bayfront village of leafy streets, sidewalk cafes, marinas and boutiques, appealing to families and travelers seeking a relaxed, upscale vibe.

water.note: Tap water is treated and safe to drink.

transit.pay: Tap a contactless credit/debit card or phone straight at Metrorail faregates and bus readers ($2.25 a ride), or buy an EASY Card (about $2) from station vending machines; the GO Miami-Dade app sells mobile tickets too. The downtown Metromover is completely free. Brightline and Tri-Rail sell their own tickets via app or station machines.
transit.hours: Metrorail and Metromover run daily from about 5am to midnight; a handful of Metrobus routes run 24 hours.

transit.m: MIA Mover to Metrorail Orange Line to downtown (45 min)
Airport Express bus 150 to Miami Beach (40 min)
